t: This Fortress Trade stripping knife is an essential decorating tool designed for efficient removal of wallpaper and other surface coverings. It is ideal for professional decorators and DIY enthusiasts tackling renovation projects, ensuring quick preparation of walls and ceilings. The 75mm hardened and tempered steel blade offers excellent durability and rust resistance, making light work of stripping large areas. Its ergonomic polypropylene and TPR-handled soft-grip ensures comfortable use and reduced hand fatigue during prolonged tasks, providing reliable performance for demanding trade applications.
